QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_40

question.text: Per SEBI Circular dated September 10, 2025, Angel Funds are required to report investment-wise valuation and cash-flow data to benchmarking agencies starting from which financial year?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (page 164), the SEBI circular dated September 10, 2025 requires Angel Funds to report investment-wise valuation and cash-flow data to benchmarking agencies from FY 2025-26 onwards. The Trap: FY 2023-24 and FY 2024-25 pre-date the circular's effective year. FY 2026-27 is later than the year specified in the circular. Note: The reporting trigger is stated in the page 164 paragraph on Angel Fund reporting and is footnoted to the September 10, 2025 SEBI circular.
